pricing.heading: Free is real. Plus is power. X is wings.
pricing.body: Resonance works without paying. Resonance+ and Resonance X add depth for people who want more signal, more reach, and more places.

free.title: Start with intent
free.features: Daily queue · Limited likes · Full safety stack · Events RSVP

plus.title: Deeper signal
plus.features: See who likes you · More Pulses · Advanced filters · Nearby feed

x.title: Go anywhere
x.features: Everything in + · Travel mode · Priority placement · X-only events

q1.a: Yes. The daily queue, limited likes, messaging, events, and the full safety stack are free forever. Resonance+ and X add convenience and reach — never core safety.

q2.a: Because attention is the ingredient. A small queue means every profile gets read, every like means something, and the app can optimize for dates instead of time-on-screen.

q3.a: During onboarding you take a selfie and pass a quick live check. Verified members get a badge; unverified accounts can’t browse or be seen. It takes under a minute.

q4.a: A Pulse is a super-like with weight. It pins you to the top of their Likes You grid with a violet underline. They’re intentionally scarce — free members get a few per week.

q5.a: Daily Queue, Classic Swipe, and Events are free. Nearby Feed is Resonance+. Travel mode is Resonance X. Filters and dealbreakers are free in every mode.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.intro: Most dating apps punish people. Resonance is built to be on your side — and every rule below exists to keep two promises at once: we protect you from people who'd hurt you, and we never treat an honest mistake like a crime.

promise.title: Our promise
promise.p1: We protect you from the people who would hurt you — scammers, harassers, fakes. Firmly and fast.
promise.p2: We never treat an honest mistake like a crime. A clumsy sentence, a quiet week, a conversation that fizzled — these are human, and we respond with teaching and coaching, not punishment. When we enforce, we explain. When we remove, we give a way back.

twoTiers.title: Two kinds of rules
twoTiers.p1: Resonance never uses one punishment ladder for everything. There are exactly two tiers, and they never mix.
twoTiers.safetyBody: The serious ones: no scam or fraud patterns, no harassment, threats, or hate, no fake identity behind a verified badge. Break these and you get a strike — a private warning that teaches. Worst case, at strike three and only after a human review, an account can be removed. Always with appeal.
twoTiers.kindBody: The everyday ones: reply when you can, close loops kindly, don't vanish without a word. Break these and the worst that happens is a friendly nudge or quietly reduced visibility — never a strike, never a removal, never a public mark against you.
twoTiers.p2: A kindness slip can never add up to a strike. Only the three safety categories can.

strike.title: What's a strike?
strike.p1: A strike is a private warning that teaches, not punishes. It always quotes the rule and shows what triggered it, and it's only visible to you, in Settings → Your standing.
strike.s1: Strike 1: we show you the rule and what happened — most people just didn't know.
strike.s2: Strike 2: a clear final warning, in plain words.
strike.s3: Strike 3: the account is removed — but a human always reviews first, and you can always appeal.
strike.p2: Strikes expire 90 days after they're issued, automatically. One report or one flagged phrase alone can never create a strike — every strike needs corroboration, and every removal is reviewed by a human before it happens.

money.title: The one money rule
money.p1: Talking about crypto or investing here is always fine — learning is welcome, and the topic is never flagged. Ever.
money.p2: One bright line: never send money or crypto to someone you haven't met in person. If a conversation starts moving that way, we warn the person being asked — that's Scam Shield — and nobody is accused of anything.

kindness.title: Kindness rules
kindness.p1: People vanish for real reasons — life happens, conversations fade. Ghosting gets coaching, never punishment: a gentle close-the-loop nudge, one-tap kind goodbyes, and earned badges for good habits. Closing the loop kindly is always easier than vanishing.
kindness.p2: Kindness rules never produce a strike, a suspension, or a removal — and nothing negative ever shows on your profile. Someone who goes quiet because they felt unsafe is never penalized.

removal.title: When an account is removed
removal.p1: Removal happens only at strike three, only after a human reviews everything, and always with an appeal path — a different reviewer answers within 72 hours and decides within 7 days. A successful appeal restores everything exactly as it was.
removal.p2: The other person sees only a neutral line — “This account is no longer on Resonance.” Never a reason, never a label. Removals can be wrong; that's exactly why the appeal exists.
